annotations.text:
CHOKEPOINT — Direction A, built out. Team S.S.Dee.

Landing page carries all five required sections (01-05) plus how-it-works, sources, and an honest "what this is not". Copy and every figure come from the repo: 265 -> 14, ~92% prefilter, 75 nodes / 24 edges, the Hualien event study, confidence 0.35 for the offline heuristic.

Two things are NOT from the repo: the target user (still unvalidated - flagged on the page itself) and the per-source document counts in section 01, which are a plausible split of the real 265 total.

The two app artboards are clickable. In the digest: severity and commodity filters (severity 5 reaches the empty state), the confirmed-only toggle, and clicking any entry loads its drafted alert on the right. On mobile: the ALERT / PATH / SOURCES tabs.

The six digest entries are SAMPLE events - lag ranges traced against config/entities.yaml, but the events themselves are invented. Swap them for a real run before this goes in front of anyone.
